verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site says its changelog page can "Subscribe users to email updates," and it supports segmented, targeted release notes. That directly matches customers subscribing to email updates for new changelog entries. The support rests only on short marketing copy. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the subscription flow (opt-in, management, unsubscribe, trigger on publish), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can let customers subscribe to email updates when new changelog entries are published

citations.quote: Segment your product releases by user attributes to always send out targeted release notes.
